layout.source: 4 columns × 4 rows; calm 8 cels followed by stern 8 cels

prompts.ghost:
Use case: identity-preserve / game animation cel redraw.
EDIT TARGET: the supplied sprite sheet is the approved exact character design. Preserve its palette, face, head/body proportions, outline weight, chunky pixel clusters, shading highlights, clothing and equipment. Redraw animation poses with the SAME pixel-art fidelity; do not simplify the character into a crude low-resolution symbol. Crisp square pixel edges, no blur, no smooth vector edges.
OUTPUT: one transparent square sprite sheet, exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, 16 equal SQUARE cells, no gutters, labels, borders, shadows or scenery. Every figure must fit completely inside its own cell with at least 7% transparent padding. Never let weapons or wings cross cell boundaries. Character scale is constant across all frames, approximately 80% cell height for ground creatures. Cells are read left-to-right, then top-to-bottom.
NEW LAYOUT (replace the old attack/hit layout): top TWO rows = ONE continuous eight-frame calm IDLE DANCE cycle. Bottom TWO rows = the SAME eight dance poses with the reference's subtly stern eyebrows and tiny coral cheek accents. These are not attacks or damage poses. Preserve identity between moods.
ART DIRECTION: small rhythmic Helltaker-inspired idle groove, bouncy, relaxed and cute. Articulated local poses, not rigid whole-image rotation. A complete left-right phrase lasts 960ms, 120ms per frame, two soft downbeats. Preserve exact eye style and limb count. The final frame must flow smoothly back to the first. No big jumps, motion lines, duplicate limbs, extra effects, emoji or text.
CHARACTER: the exact friendly icy-blue ghost with rounded head/body, cream highlight upper left, two black rectangular eyes, tiny dark mouth, two little side arms and THREE scalloped tails. It floats rather than having feet. Eight pose phrase: 1 gentle left downbeat with left side lowered and right arm higher, 2 left rebound and tails lag right, 3 upright rising center with arms relaxed, 4 transition right with left arm lifted, 5 gentle right downbeat with right side lowered, 6 right rebound and tails lag left, 7 centered rising recovery with alternate arm swing, 8 transition left. Body has small locally redrawn bends and swaying hem, not whole-image rotation. Keep its head size/face stable and center nearly fixed; only a few pixels of bobbing. Bottom eight poses repeat the same dance with subtly stern mood.

refinements.goblin:
EDIT ONLY the idle poses of this exact goblin sprite sheet. Keep the same beautiful detailed pixel artwork, green face, vest, shorts, wooden club, 4x4 equal square-cell transparent layout and calm top8 / red-cheek stern bottom8. All 16 cells are tiny rhythmic IDLE DANCE, NONE is an attack.
Specific corrections: the current row2 and row4 columns2/3 look like attack poses. Redraw those so the club ALWAYS hangs naturally DOWNWARD beside the SCREEN LEFT thigh, never above shoulder height, never thrust horizontally, mouth ALWAYS the same small closed mischievous smile. Every cell must have the same feet positions: left sole at x=38%-48% of its cell, right sole at x=60%-70%, both flat on y=91%. No lifting feet, changing stance width, or rigid rotation of the whole person.
Make one smooth eight-frame left-right groove: top row1-4 = left dip -> left rebound -> upright -> drifting right. Second row1-4 = right dip -> right rebound -> upright -> drifting left. The hips move only 3-4% cell width and dip 3% cell height, short knees visibly bend. The torso counters the hip motion, head nods/tilts subtly, elbow and dangling club lag slightly. Ankles remain in place. The bottom two rows repeat those same eight gestures with existing small stern brow and cheek marks.
The motion should look like a character casually dancing along to a beat with planted feet, not fighting or moving across the screen. Same scale and pixel shading in every cel, no loss of details. Include at least 7% transparent padding in EVERY cell, including ears and club, no bleed across cells, no text or gridlines. Do not change palette or proportions.
refinements.skeleton:
Edit this exact 4x4 transparent pixel-art skeleton sheet, preserving ALL the detailed artwork, palette, helmet/skull proportions, sword on SCREEN LEFT and round shield on SCREEN RIGHT. This sheet contains calm eight-frame idle dance in the top two rows, and the same eight-frame stern dance with small cheek marks in the bottom two rows.
Only correct the gestures: in row2 and row4 columns2 and3 the sword looks as if it is attacking. Redraw these to be relaxed idle dancing. In ALL cells keep the sword beside the LEFT hip at the same relaxed diagonal angle, pointing up-left, never thrust it horizontally or raise it above the helmet. Shield hangs at right hip, swaying only slightly. Keep the equipment fully inside each cell.
Make the whole 8-frame sequence visibly sway left then right in one small, smooth Helltaker-style groove. BOTH soles always at y=91% of each cell on a level baseline; feet fixed at x38-48% and x60-70%, ankles stay planted, no sliding or jumping. Short knees bend alternately, pelvis shifts 3% left/right and dips 3%, ribcage counters the hips, skull/helmet nod slightly one frame later. Tiny articulated changes rather than rotating a whole rigid character. Do not stretch head or limbs, lose ribs or simplify shading.
Top row: left downbeat, left rebound, upright recovery, right anticipation. Second row: right downbeat, right rebound, upright recovery, left anticipation. Bottom two rows same gestures with existing stern brows and subtle cheek accents. Same constant scale, at least 7% clear padding in every cell, no gridlines, labels or background.
